updates.title: CVE-2026-69851 Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege via SSRF
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to elevate their privileges over the network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent lateral movement and privilege escalation within their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836 Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution via Deserialization
updates.summary: Untrusted data deserialization in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network. This critical vulnerability requires immediate patching to prevent complete identity infrastructure compromise.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Sync SLA Reduced to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: DLP policy updates now sync 4x faster—from 2 hours to 30 minutes—ensuring compliance protections take effect across the organization more quickly. Admins can rely on quicker policy deployment when responding to security incidents or compliance changes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Protection for Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP now prevents sensitive data from being used in external web searches within Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, mitigating data leakage risks. Organizations can now control whether AI-assisted workflows expose sensitive information to external search engines.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Archive Support for SharePoint
updates.summary: Administrators can now include file archiving actions in retention policies, moving inactive SharePoint content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable. This extends DLM capabilities beyond retention and deletion to optimize storage costs without sacrificing compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Tips Launched for Outlook Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now alert Mac users in real-time when emails contain sensitive information that violates organizational policies, with options to remove non-compliant recipients or override. This extends endpoint DLP enforcement to macOS users who previously lacked this protection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Tips Launched for Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: DLP policy tip support on Outlook Mobile delivers real-time alerts to prevent users from accidentally sharing sensitive information on mobile devices. This closes a gap in mobile compliance enforcement where users previously had no policy guidance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: Investigators can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to automatically gather files that triggered violations in a specific timeframe and location. This streamlines incident response by reducing manual file correlation steps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Retention Policy Support for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory stored in user Exchange mailboxes, enabling historical preservation for security and compliance investigations. This allows organizations to govern AI interaction data the same way they manage other sensitive information.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM Hard Delete via Secure Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now supports permanent hard deletion of OneDrive and SharePoint content through priority cleanup workflows with multi-approval gates. This addresses compliance requirements for irreversible data removal while maintaining safeguards against accidental deletion.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Triage Agent Reasoning Trace and Confidence Scores
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now provides explainable confidence scores and reasoning traces alongside each alert decision, enabling analysts to trust automation without bypassing manual review. This transparency improves SOC efficiency by signaling which agent outputs are reliable versus uncertain.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager Integration with AI Foundry Agents
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will automatically map AI Foundry Agents to compliance regulations and assessments, allowing organizations to monitor the compliance posture of generative AI applications. This extends compliance governance to cover AI models and agents, a growing concern for regulated organizations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview AI-Powered Regulatory Templates for Compliance Manager
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will use AI to convert complex PDF regulations into actionable controls and assessments in multi-cloud environments, accelerating compliance gap identification. This reduces manual compliance mapping effort for organizations managing regulations across multiple cloud platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled before enforcement, with insights showing match results and source distribution. Administrators can validate policy logic safely before rolling out changes that affect organizational content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: The Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details now provides at-a-glance views of policy performance in simulation or enforcement mode, helping administrators understand content identification and labeling patterns. This visibility improves confidence in policy tuning and effectiveness measurement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications. This extends DLP enforcement beyond Microsoft 365 to browsers, APIs, and add-ins, including generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Priority Cleanup Hard Delete Requires Triple Approval
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now mandate three separate approvals—from a Priority Cleanup admin, retention manager, and eDiscovery admin—before permanent content deletion. This governance model reduces the risk of unauthorized or misconfigured deletions affecting critical data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Classification Failure Detection for Exchange
updates.summary: Exchange Online DLP now detects and reports classification failures caused by timeouts, throttling, and scanning errors, allowing admins to apply targeted protection actions via the DocumentScanFailures condition. This improves visibility into DLP processing issues that may leave content unprotected.
